error.title: {{name}} wasn't imported
error.notSettings: This isn't an Oleafly settings file.
error.invalid: The settings config you tried to import is invalid, please fix these errors and try importing again:

valueErrors.range: must be a number from {{min}} to {{max}}
valueErrors.wholeRange: must be a whole number from {{min}} to {{max}}
valueErrors.wholeRangeStep: must be a whole number from {{min}} to {{max}}, in steps of {{step}}
valueErrors.hexColorOrEmpty: must be a color like #2563eb, or "" to use the theme's color
valueErrors.text: must be text, at most {{max}} characters
valueErrors.list: must be a list of at most {{max}} entries
valueErrors.object: must be a group of settings in braces
valueErrors.dictionaryLocale: must be a dictionary code like en_US
valueErrors.shortcut: must be a shortcut like Mod-Shift-k, or "default"
valueErrors.editorKey: must be a key like Mod-d, "" for none, or "default"
